One thing I want to be straight with you about: part of it went back to your PayPal, and the larger part went back to your account balance, because that's how the order was paid at checkout. You asked for money only, so I've put that in front of Abel and Georges now.

They're on and will jump into this chat. Stay with me and I'll keep you posted.

Hi, but it deosn't make any sense only 15 dollars are refund and majority are still in credits... what am i going to do with the credits i can't even purchase the old units that were supposed to be ship out.

You're right to push on it, and it isn't a good answer. The system sent it back the same way it came in, and the store credit part was credit when you paid, so that's where it returned. That isn't me refusing you money, it's just not a switch I can throw.

Abel and Georges have it in front of them now, with exactly what you said: cash, not credit. Stay in the chat and one of them will come in here with the answer.
